data.one_liner: Read and write Dart package configuration files.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to locate, read, and write .dart_tool/package_config.json files. Offers discovery functions and typed models for package configurations. No longer supports legacy .packages files.
use_when: You need to resolve package URIs in tooling or build scripts
You are building a Dart tool that must read or modify the package configuration
avoid_when: You only need simple path manipulation without package resolution
Your project targets Dart versions older than 3.4
strengths: Official API that follows the Dart package config spec
Discovery functions simplify locating config files
Typed models are sealed and ready for future immutability
weaknesses: Only handles package configuration, not a general utility library
Requires Dart 3.4+, so not usable on older SDKs
